desc: Persistent cross-run ledger of every family found at any layer, all forbidden from the start of the next run, plus replicated, shuffled judge scoring ranked by lower confidence bound to filter out noise

A forecaster agent predicts the likely outputs or families in advance; originality is computed as distance from those forecasts and from a cross-run archive, with paired replicates and bandit technique selection gated on variance

Literature or retrieval moved to the front to build evidence-backed problem cards or constraint dossiers; every idea must name the documented cost or constraint it removes, and value is scored against that evidence; unsolved items persist and gain weight across runs

In-pipeline falsification: each survivor carries cheap, pre-registered decisive checks (Fermi estimate, code simulation, search with a predicted result) that a verifier or red-team agent runs; value is weighted by survival, and failure patterns are stored to steer later runs and crossover

Asymmetric crossover: the more concrete parent becomes a fixed build sheet, the other parent grafts exactly one mechanism into a named step, a checker rejects blurred fields, and successful pairings are remembered

Break the shared-blind-spot problem with heterogeneous judges (different model providers, simulated domain-expert personas, or adversarial judges with distinct knowledge prompts) and score on their disagreement or agreement
Replace absolute scores with pairwise or tournament (Elo or Bradley-Terry) comparisons against plain-answer baselines to reduce judge noise and calibrate value
Quality-diversity archive (MAP-Elites style) over originality x value x family niches, keeping the best idea per cell instead of a single ranked list
Multi-objective selection with a hard value floor: only ideas that match or beat the plain-answer baseline on value are kept, then ranked by originality on the Pareto front
Add a critique-and-revise elaboration stage after generation or crossover that restores concreteness (implementation steps, metrics, first experiment) before final judging
Seed generation with retrieved cross-domain analogies or distant-field mechanisms, mapped onto the question to produce originality grounded in proven mechanisms
